## Architecture Notes

3D Tetris (Vite + TypeScript + Three.js). See `3D_Tetris_GDD.md` for the design spec.

**Golden rule — logic is the source of truth.** All collision, rotation, layer
clearing, scoring, and game-over decisions run on the integer grid in `src/core/`.
The renderer only mirrors that state; Three.js mesh transforms never drive game
logic.

**Coordinate systems.**
- Logic: `grid[z][y][x]` where `z` is the vertical/fall axis (0 = floor, 19 = top
  of the visible well, 20–23 = hidden spawn buffer; internal height 24). `x`/`y`
  are the horizontal footprint (W = D ∈ {5, 7, 9, 11}).
- Render mapping (`Renderer`): logic `z → world Y (up)`, `x → world X`,
  `y → world Z`, so a cube sits at `(x-(W-1)/2, z+0.5, y-(D-1)/2)`.

**Layers, not lines.** A clear happens when a whole horizontal layer (fixed `z`)
is full; that layer is removed and everything above collapses down one step.
Multiple simultaneously-full layers are all handled in one pass.

**Module map.**
- `core/` — pure game logic: `Board` (well + clears), `Piece` (rigid body,
  move/rotate/ghost), `GameManager` (state machine, gravity, lock delay, hold,
  spin, spawn/game-over), plus `pieces`/`rotation`/`rng`/`scoring`/`storage`.
- `render/` — `Renderer` (instanced cubes + bloom, pulls state each frame),
  `CameraRig` (outer-rail orbit, corner/face modes), `effects`, `materials`.
- `input/` — keyboard with DAS/ARR and camera-relative movement remapping.
- `ui/` — HTML/CSS overlays for menu/settings/HUD/pause/game-over.
- `audio/` — self-contained WebAudio SFX.

**State machine.** `menu → settings → playing ⇄ paused → gameover`. `main.ts`
wires the pieces together, owns the run lifecycle (records + total play time via
`storage`), and runs the animation loop.

## File Overview

| Path | Overview | Key symbols | Git delta |
|---|---|---|---|
| `electron/main.cjs` | Creates the secure Electron desktop window and loads the packaged Vite dist entry point without a local server. | `createWindow` | A |
| `src/audio/Sound.ts` | Generates self-contained WebAudio arcade sound effects for gameplay actions and events. | `Sound` | — |
| `src/core/Board.ts` | Implements the discrete 3D well, collision checks, full-layer detection, and layer clearing. | `BoardCell`, `Board` | — |
| `src/core/GameManager.ts` | Owns the game state machine, gravity, lock delay, spawning, hold, spin detection, and layer-clear resolution, and reports the settled stack height for camera framing. | `GameEvents`, `GameManager` | — |
| `src/core/Piece.ts` | Represents the active tetromino and computes occupied cells, movement, rotation, drop distance, and ghost cells. | `Piece` | — |
| `src/core/constants.ts` | Central tunables: board dimensions (default 5x5), input timing, scoring table, gravity curve, and neon piece colors. | `VISIBLE_HEIGHT`, `SPAWN_BUFFER`, `BOARD_HEIGHT`, `DEFAULT_BOARD_SIZE`, `BOARD_SIZES`, `DAS_MS` | — |
| `src/core/orient.ts` | Quantizes camera yaw for consistent board-axis input mapping and HUD compass orientation. | `yawStepIndex`, `snappedYaw`, `yawResidual` | — |
| `src/core/pieces.ts` | Defines canonical tetromino cell offsets and cloning helpers. | `PIECE_OFFSETS`, `cloneOffsets` | — |
| `src/core/rng.ts` | Produces a fair 7-bag tetromino sequence with next-piece preview support. | `BagRandomizer` | — |
| `src/core/rotation.ts` | Performs integer 90-degree cell rotations and supplies wall-kick candidates. | `rotateCell`, `rotateOffsets`, `KICK_OFFSETS` | — |
